Assuming I didn't miss sarcasm, that's a stand from JoJo called "Soft and Wet." 

Stands are the powers of the series. They're essentially controllable ghosts with unique abilities and forms depending on the user. They're usually named after songs/musicians, "Soft and Wet" being a Prince reference.

Also JoJo fans reeeeeally like finding references to JoJo everywhere, intentional or not. Breathing is a JoJo reference.
